//: obsidian-chronicle configuration. Copy to one of:
//vaultPath: Vault root. Absolute or ~. If omitted everywhere, the plugin tries `obsidian vault` (CLI); if that fails too, it writes nothing.
//sessionsDir: Session-note dir. Relative -> joined to vaultPath. Leading / or ~ = absolute.
//dailyDir: Daily-note dir. Optional; defaults to <sessionsDir>/Daily Notes.
//model: Model for `claude -p` summaries: sonnet (recommended) | haiku | opus.
//language: Output language for summary / title / headings. Any language name, passed verbatim to the prompt. Defaults to English.
//log: Append-only hook activity log (lives outside the vault).
//minBytes: Skip if extracted conversation is smaller than this.
//maxBytes: Skip if extracted conversation is larger (protects `claude -p`).
